notes: Jump straight to a hymn number. Tag a hymnal, step through it once to build its index, and after that the bookmark button opens a number pad: type the hymn number and you are there. Service music numbered with a letter, like S115, works too, and a link can point at a hymn as well as a page. Importing a large scan now shows its progress instead of looking frozen, and sending very large pieces to a second tablet is more reliable. Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
